newsitem.title: USA: Exploration Co gets $2.1 mln cash infusion.
newsitem.headline: Exploration Co gets $2.1 mln cash infusion.

text.p: Exploration Co said on Tuesday it it received an infusion of $2.1 million in cash from investors from Europe, Australia and Singapore as well as about $4.5 million of leases in the Williston Basin.
The company had said on June 11 it expected additional capital of between $3 million and $6.1 million.
The capital raises the assets of the company from $2.9 million to an unaudited estimate of $9 million and it improves the company's liquidity and current ratio, Exploration said.
